name: OpenPets
summary: Local-first desktop app that places animated pets on the desktop with plugins and agent integrations.
use_cases: manage work cycles with focus timers
open folders and apps via shortcuts
features: crack open a daily fortune cookie

usage_guide.open_hint: Open OpenPets from Applications to place the animated pet on the desktop.

features.title: Show animated companion pets on the desktop
Set snoozeable reminders
steps: Right-click the desktop pet to open its menu.
Open Quick Reminders and click Test reminder.
Click Snooze 5m or Done in the reminder bubble.

features.feature: crack open a daily fortune cookie
features.title: Open a daily fortune cookie
steps: Right-click the desktop pet to open its menu.
Open Daily Fortune Cookie and click Read today's fortune.

features.title: Run Pomodoro focus sessions
steps: Right-click the desktop pet to open its menu.
Open Focus Buddy and click Start focus session.
Open the pet menu again and click Show status to see time left.

operations.goal: Right-click the animated desktop pet (the cat on the desktop) to open its menu. Open the Quick Reminders submenu and click Test reminder. Wait for the reminder alert bubble to appear showing the test message with Snooze and Done buttons.
operations.observed: on screen (read by the screen judge, muse-spark-1.3, from pickfit's last screenshot): "This is a test reminder": yes; "Snooze 5m": yes

operations.feature: crack open a daily fortune cookie
operations.goal: Right-click the animated desktop pet (the cat) to open its menu. Open the Daily Fortune Cookie submenu and click Read today's fortune. Wait for the fortune speech bubble to appear above the pet showing Today's fortune.
operations.observed: on screen (read by the screen judge, muse-spark-1.3, from pickfit's last screenshot): "Today's fortune": yes

operations.goal: Right-click the animated desktop pet (the cat) to open its menu. Open the Focus Buddy submenu and click Start focus session. Then open the pet menu again and click Show status. Wait for the focus timer bubble or HUD showing minutes left to appear.

You do not need to be a developer or connect any AI agents to enjoy OpenPets.
A desktop companion platform with pets, plugins, and optional local agent integrations.
OpenPets puts an animated companion on your desktop, then lets plugins turn it into a focus buddy, reminder system, tiny game, launcher, or coding-agent sidekick.
OpenPets puts an animated companion on your desktop
Pomodoro-style focus timers to manage work cycles.
Renders snoozeable, bell-alert notifications with custom audio tones.
Allows registering shortcut commands to quickly open local folders, projects, or applications.
OpenPets will never paywall core features, the plugin SDK, or agent integrations
